* Null out the folder's database to avoid memory bloat if we don't have a
   *  reason to keep the database around.  Currently, we keep all Inboxes
   *  around and null out everyone else.  This is a standard stopgap measure
   *  until we have something more clever going on.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted view code retains large databases as well as Inboxes, although its comment still says it nulls everyone else. The cache manager no longer checks open windows, although its maximum-count comment still says those folders were skipped. A scoped comment repair should state the actual size and database-reference conditions. These stale comments are not evidence of a current window exemption. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Update retention comments when their exemption changes
